g.text: Network topology and host address configuration are separate choices

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Topology sketches distinguish logical star,bus,ring,full mesh and tree; physical cabling may differ. DHCPv4 sequence is a simplified initial lease
exchange. SLAAC uses link-local setup, eligible router-advertised prefixes and duplicate address detection; default-router discovery is related but
separate. IID generation need not use a MAC address.
